concerns.text: Task T016 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T012 (HumanEval download) to access the dataset. A task that consumes an artifact (the dataset) cannot run in parallel with the task that produces it (T012). The [P] tag must be removed to enforce sequential execution.

Task T017 (Generation Pipeline) is marked [P] but lists dependencies on T013, T014, T015, AND T016. Since T016 is a sequential prerequisite (see above), T017 cannot be parallel-safe relative to the foundational data flow. The [P] tag is misleading and should be removed or the dependency graph clarified to show it waits for the entire Phase 2/3 foundation.

Task T036 (Sensitivity Analysis) depends on T017 (Raw Candidate Pool) and Phase 4 (Inference). However, the description states it must 'Re-score the raw candidate pool... against each threshold'. If T036 runs before T018 (Filtering) is complete, it might access a stale or incomplete raw file if T017 is still writing. More critically, T036 depends on T021 (Inference) to calculate pass@1 rates, but the dependency list only explicitly cites T017 and Phase 4. The ordering must ensure T021 (Inference) completes before T036 attempts to correlate thresholds with pass rates.

Task T038 (ECE Analysis) depends on T026 (Confidence Extraction). T026 depends on T021 (Inference). The dependency chain is correct, but T038 is marked [P] in the 'Parallel Opportunities' section. T038 cannot run in parallel with T021 or T026. It must strictly follow T026. The [P] tag in the 'Parallel Opportunities' section is incorrect for T038.

The 'Parallel Opportunities' section lists T032, T033, T035, T036, T037, T038 as parallel after Phase 4. However, T036 (Sensitivity) and T038 (ECE) have specific internal dependencies (T017/T021 and T026 respectively) that prevent them from being truly parallel with T032/T033/T035 if those tasks also depend on the same upstream data. The grouping implies they can all start simultaneously, which is false for T036 and T038.
